name: siege_style_v3_verified_objectives_first_development
candidate_family: Same standardized raw ridge family, alpha=1, plus plants+disables per round from completing_timer_owner_v1
cohort: Original v2 train events and EWC development validation only; both September final events excluded
quality: Original K/D, round-count and independently checked alias gates; exclude entire maps with any unresolved objective actor or parse/alignment failure
controlled_inputs: Keep the original frozen v2 eight round-feature inputs identically in both arms, including original KOST, to isolate addition of the verified objective feature. Fully rederived KOST changes are reported separately rather than silently changing a second feature.
target_policy: No third-party objective actor or map objective total enters features or eligibility. Cached public Rating labels only within original development split.
baseline_sample_warning: The v2 baseline retains its original training coefficients; the candidate uses only objective-complete development maps. Report sample differences and all coefficient drift; do not attribute every drift solely to the objective feature.
outputs: Separate ignored v3 datasets, normalized research maps and model; append one deduplicated development experiment record
final_holdout: A different, untouched professional event must be metadata-reserved and v3 frozen before final target errors are evaluated. Old NA Stage2 is permanently consumed.
